turns.question: Which country had the lowest average daily order revenue from 17 August to 2 October 2026, counting days with no orders from that country as zero and excluding cancelled orders, and what was that average?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric, so I cannot give that average (and I do not compute figures myself); the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR), which excludes cancelled orders, and Orders, by customer country. Over 17 August to 2 October 2026 (inclusive), total Revenue (EUR) was lowest for US at 1498.25 EUR, then FR 1830.79, GB 3663.3, NL 4016.25, TR 4180.25 and DE 4317.75 EUR. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
